capture.title: Capture
capture.subtitle: Capture meeting audio from a virtual audio device, transcribe and translate it live.
capture.deviceHint: Pick the virtual audio device carrying the meeting audio (VB-Cable on Windows, BlackHole on macOS) and point Teams' output at it. Do not mute the playback device instead — muting makes the capture silent.
capture.silentWarning: Recording for several seconds with no audio at all. Check that Teams outputs to the selected virtual device and that the device is not muted.
capture.noTranslator: No translation key is configured — this meeting will be transcribed but not translated.
capture.noTranslatorLink: Set one up in LLM settings.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Transcripts and translations from past meetings.
sessions.speakersHint: Speakers are told apart by voice, but the app never sees the participant list. Name them once here and the transcript shows real names.
sessions.mergeHint: When one person was split into several speakers, tick them and merge — the transcript folds them into one. Name them first, then merge.
sessions.editHint: Click to correct. The fix is remembered and applied to later meetings.
sessions.importHint: A meeting recorded elsewhere becomes a session like any other: name the speakers to teach their voices, correct a line to teach the fix. Video or audio; the audio track is extracted with ffmpeg.
sessions.importUrlPlaceholder: Or paste a link or a server path — YouTube, \\nas\meetings\…
sessions.suggestApplyHint: Below the auto-naming bar — a hint, not a verdict. Click to adopt the name.
sessions.suggestApplyHintWording: The voiceprints couldn't tell them apart; this is judged from this person's wording habits (pet phrases, filler words). Please listen before applying.
sessions.suggestApplyHintUnsure: The voiceprints can't tell these two apart — listen to a sample of each before deciding which one to apply.
sessions.suggestPlayHint: Play {{name}}'s learned voice to compare against this speaker.
sessions.fragmentHint: This speaker has only a few scattered lines, each right at a speaker change — the sample may mix in someone else's voice. Check the transcript and merge it into the real person instead of naming it.
sessions.refiningHint: A more accurate pass is running over the whole recording. Editing is locked until it finishes, because it replaces every line.
sessions.refineDone: Refining finished — the transcript has been updated
sessions.reassignSpeaker: Reassign this line to another speaker
sessions.playFailed: No audio recorded for this line.
sessions.noRecording: The recording for this meeting is no longer on disk, so nothing here can be played back.
sessions.pipHint: Pop out as picture-in-picture — movable to another screen
sessions.videoDragHint: Drag to move; drag the corner to resize
sessions.reprocessHint: Re-derives this transcript from the recording with the largest model. Every line is replaced, so corrections made by hand here are lost.
sessions.reprocessConfirm: Reprocess this meeting? Every line is rewritten, so anything you corrected here by hand is lost. Words in the glossary and corrections already learned are kept.
sessions.deleteHint: Deletes this meeting's transcript, summary and recording. Learned speakers and the glossary are kept.
sessions.deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting? The transcript, summary and recording are removed and cannot be recovered. Learned speakers and the glossary are kept.
sessions.playUnavailable: The server could not return this clip (HTTP {{status}}).
sessions.playUnreachable: Could not reach the server to play this line.
sessions.playStaleServer: This build of the server has no playback endpoint — restart the backend to pick it up.
sessions.exportHint: Download this transcript as Markdown — speaker names, timestamps and every translation as they stand now.
sessions.exportDocxHint: Download this transcript as a Word document — summary, speakers and transcript, ready to hand over.
sessions.exportVttHint: Download the spoken transcript as a WebVTT subtitle track — drop it onto the meeting video in any player.
sessions.referenceHint: Agenda, attendees or terms to expect. Folded into the summary prompt when it regenerates.
sessions.referencePlaceholder: Agenda, attendee names, product or project names…
sessions.summaryFailed: The summary could not be generated.
sessions.summaryNoLlm: No language model is configured — set an API key (or an Ollama endpoint) on the Settings page, then generate the summary.
sessions.summaryStale: The transcript has been edited since this summary was generated — regenerate it to catch up.

glossary.title: Glossary
glossary.subtitle: Terms are forced into every translation, either as a fixed rendering or kept untranslated.
glossary.clashWarning: Careful: this sounds identical to {{list}} already in your transcripts, and adding it would rewrite them. If those are real words, add them in protect mode too.

modeHelp.translate: Always use the translation you provide.
modeHelp.keep: Never translate it — right for English terms shared across a cross-border team (schedule, delay).
modeHelp.hint: Improves speech recognition without affecting translation.
modeHelp.protect: Protect declares a word real: never corrected, and nothing is ever corrected into it. For everyday words that sound like a term — 才夠 against 採購.

display.title: Subtitles
display.subtitle: Choose the language set and how subtitles are laid out on the TV.
display.languagesHint: Pick 2 or 3 languages. The app detects which one is being spoken and translates into the rest.
display.openLive: Open subtitle page (press F11 for fullscreen on the TV)

llm.subtitle: The model that drives automatic translation.
llm.primaryRequired: The primary tab needs a provider and model.
llm.perFunctionHint: Point each function at its own model. Leave blank to use the primary model above.
llm.apiKeySet: Key stored — leave blank to keep it
llm.apiKeyStored: Leave blank to keep the stored key
llm.perProviderFallbackHint: Extra models of this provider, tried in order after the model above.

keyproxy.title: LLM keys
keyproxy.subtitle: API keys the translator rotates through. Add keys from different accounts so a rate limit switches to the next.
keyproxy.accountNote: Rotation only helps across separate accounts — free quotas are counted per account, not per key.
keyproxy.voiceHint: How many of those requests were speech transcription
keyproxy.quotaNoneHint: This provider does not report a quota

errorBoundary.title: Something went wrong
errorBoundary.description: The page failed to load. Reloading usually fixes it.

connectionLost.title: Connection lost
connectionLost.message: Cannot reach the local service. Check that it is still running.

learned.title: Learned
learned.subtitle: What the room has picked up from ordinary use, and how to undo it
learned.voicesNote: Naming a speaker on a transcript stores their voiceprint. Later meetings label that voice automatically.
learned.noVoices: No voices learned yet. Name a speaker on a transcript to teach one.
learned.correctionsNote: Correcting a line on a transcript stores what was written against what was said, and applies it to every transcript afterwards.
learned.noCorrections: No corrections learned yet. Edit a transcript line to teach one.
learned.confirmForget: Forget "{{name}}"? The voiceprint and all samples will be deleted with it.
learned.confirmDeleteClip: Delete this sample? The naming from that meeting and the voiceprint learned from it are revoked with it.

ask.title: Ask
ask.subtitle: Ask a question across every meeting and get an answer with citations to the exact lines.
ask.placeholder: Ask a question about your meetings…
ask.hint: Ask across all your recorded meetings at once.
ask.hintExample: For example: “What did we decide about the launch date?”
ask.unverified: The model gave citations but none matched a real line. Treat this answer with caution.
ask.truncated: Some meetings were read only in part: {{count}}.
ask.noAnswer: No answer was found across your meetings.
